meta.name: add-linear
meta.description: Add Linear channel integration via Chat SDK. Issue comment threads as conversations.

copy.tagline: 把 Linear 问题评论同步成聊天对话
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想把 Linear 的讨论直接搬到聊天里。
copy.tagline_en: Sync Linear issue comments into chat conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want Linear discussions to land directly in chat.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 接入 Linear:它从 channels 分支拷入 Linear 适配器并注册,参与 issue 评论线程。每条评论都触发它(无需 @ 提及),每个 issue 线程是独立会话。
howto.when: 当有人在你配置的 Linear 团队里的 issue 下发表评论时触发——webhook 驱动,无需 @ 提及。每个 issue 的评论线程会被接管为独立会话。

say.text: 帮我把 Linear 频道接进来,用 OAuth 应用身份
say.note: 会走 Apply、凭证与接线步骤

say.text: 把 Linear 团队 ENG 的评论接到指定 agent
跑一下 linear-registration 测试确认注册成功
say.note: 执行 vitest 检查适配器注册

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude adds the Linear channel: it copies and registers the Linear adapter, then takes part in issue comment threads. Every comment triggers it (no @-mention), and each issue thread is its own conversation.
howto.when_en: Triggers whenever someone comments on an issue in your configured Linear team — webhook-driven, no @-mention required. Each issue's comment thread is taken over as a separate conversation.

say_en.text: Add the Linear channel using an OAuth app identity
say_en.note: Runs the Apply, credentials and wiring steps

say_en.text: Wire comments from Linear team ENG to a given agent
say_en.note: Creates the messaging group and wiring

say_en.text: Run the linear-registration test to confirm the adapter is registered
say_en.note: Runs vitest to check adapter registration
